tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search a destination or latitude/longitude (with country) for explicit hotel-local dates (including today), or date_intent: tonight. Tonight is resolved server-side in the destination time zone, never UTC. Returns hotel summaries and the lowest eligible full-stay total from Expedia, Booking, Agoda a

tools.name: get_room_rates
tools.description: Get one identified or named hotel’s room options and provider prices for explicit hotel-local dates (including today), or date_intent: tonight, and occupancy. Tonight is resolved server-side in the hotel time zone. Accepts the exact HotelUse hotel_id from search_hotels, or hotel_name and destination

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Get undated facts for one identified or named hotel: address, photos, descriptions, star classification, sourced guest ratings, consecutive positive review count, facilities, pet/parking policies and timezone. Optional fee amounts may be absent in the catalog. Accepts the exact HotelUse hotel_id fro

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_hotels" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_hotels" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_hotel · Public sink: search_hotels, get_room_rates, get_hotel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_hotel · Public sink: search_hotels, get_room_rates, get_hotel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
